title: Star Wars Holiday Special
description: THE STAR WARS HOLIDAY SPECIAL was more like vaudeville than it was like the film. Among those appearing were Art Camey, Beatrice Arthur and Harvey Korman, who dressed as a woman to play Chef Gomaanda, the "Julia Child of the Milky Way." The special is best remembered for an animated sequence from Nelvana Studios (cels on front and back), which introduced the fierce bounty hunter, Boba Fett, and showcased the film's heroes.
